title: A Year Living Rural - What I've Learned
en: about a year and a half ago i lived by the sea i had nearly all my life as the daughter of a naval officer the ocean was a constant friend throughout my childhood i loved the sea and i felt that it left me back then one day while looking out to the exact point where the sky meets the water i realized that i needed to say goodbye this life was what i'd always known and it reflected how i felt i was afraid of risk so much so that i was more willing to keep my current job not because it suited me but because it was comfortable i also knew that i had allowed a very bad habit into my life and that was giving my mind permission to criticize everything i did only seeing where i had failed where i could have done better where i hadn't loved enough and so i began to wander and after many failed attempts at rebuilding i found my new home far from the sea enveloped by endless mountains and trees i didn't feel any different and it was humbling to realize that you can't escape who you are no matter how you distance yourself after years of searching i accepted that happiness isn't a place on earth

i had to start with my own mind which insisted on chastising every single thing i did i had to stop believing that what i wanted was unattainable and dare to see worth and who i am just as i am and that maybe what i want isn't what will make me happy as i stop trying to write my future exactly as i envisioned it my life became more meaningful but not easier than i thought it could be after years of living in cities surrounded by people i found love in a rural town which was the last thing i expected and taught me how with patience and faith things can work out a new swell of creativity came over me by working to live instead of vice versa accepting a smaller salary in exchange for the beauty of my home my fantasies i realized had to

compromise and i needed to embrace opportunities that were right in front of me instead of the ones i wished were there i got a job that offered stability even though my ideal type of work was far from it surprisingly it was just what i needed to teach me that one of our missions in life is to give and by giving my time to my community as a teacher i was filling a void that always doubted that i as one person could make a difference as you can too this week i had an awful cold and spent much of it in bed but i did try to motivate myself to tidy up a bit in preparation for winter and air out my woollens the transition between seasons made me start to reminisce about this year and how wonderful it has been to share some of it with you i've learned so much about myself and i encourage you to be proud of what you've accomplished in your life and yet humbled by what there is still to learn wherever you are wherever you live you can begin cultivating a mind that is

enriching instead of diminishing where do you focus your energy if you're at all like me and have a tendency to see your flaws over your strengths i encourage you to cultivate a gentleness of spirit that will guide you towards your inner light hold on to it and dare to be proud of who you are in a world where we might be made to feel ashamed of ourselves and where we come from uh do you
zh: 大约一年半前，我住在海边，作为一名海军军官的女儿，海洋是我童年时期不变的朋友，我热爱大海，有一天，当我眺望着天与水的交汇点时，我觉得它离开了我，我意识到我需要说再见，这种生活是我一直都知道的，它反映了我感觉我非常害怕风险，所以我更愿意保留现在的工作，不是因为它适合我，而是因为它很舒服，我也我知道我已经让一个非常坏的习惯进入了我的生活，这让我的思想允许批评我所做的一切，只看到我失败的地方，我可以做得更好的地方，我没有足够爱的地方，所以我开始徘徊，在多次重建失败的尝试之后，我发现我的新家远离大海，被无尽的山脉和树木包围，我没有感到任何不同，我谦卑地意识到，无论你如何远离自己，经过多年的寻找，你无法逃避你自己，我接受了幸福不在地球上的一个地方

我必须从自己的内心开始，它坚持惩罚我所做的每一件事，我必须停止相信我想要的东西是遥不可及的，敢于看到价值，我是谁，就像我一样，也许我想要的东西并不能让我快乐，因为我不再试图完全按照我的设想来书写我的未来，我的生活变得更有意义，但并不比我想象的更容易，在城市生活了多年，周围都是人们，我在一个乡村小镇找到了爱情，这是我最不期望的事情，并教会了我如何有了耐心和信念，事情就能解决，通过工作来生活，而不是相反，我获得了新的创造力，接受较低的薪水以换取美丽的家，我意识到我的幻想必须实现

妥协，我需要拥抱就在我面前的机会，而不是我希望的机会。我找到了一份提供稳定的工作，尽管我理想的工作类型与它相去甚远，令人惊讶的是，这正是我需要教我的，我们人生的使命之一就是给予，通过把我的时间奉献给我的社区作为一名教师，我填补了一个总是怀疑我作为一个人能否像你一样做出改变的空白，这周我得了重感冒，大部分时间都在床上，但我确实尝试激励自己整理一下，为冬天做好准备，让我的毛衣晾干。季节之间的转换让我开始回忆今年的事情，以及与你分享其中的一些经历是多么美好，我对自己有了很多了解，我鼓励你为你一生中所取得的成就感到自豪，但也为仍然需要学习的东西感到谦卑，无论你身在何处，无论你住在哪里，你都可以开始培养一种
丰富而不是减少，如果你像我一样，倾向于看到自己的缺点而不是优点，我鼓励你培养一种温柔的精神，引导你走向内心的光明，坚持下去，敢于为自己感到自豪，在这个世界上，我们可能会为自己感到羞耻，我们来自哪里，呃，你呢？
